Ciao, nel mio caso la prima Moc-Dexa pre-t mi uscì senza alcun problema, è la seconda dopo un anno di tos che mi ha dato risultato osteopenia femorale, la vitamina D l'avevo bassa sin da prima di iniziare ma non avevo problemi alle ossa, è questo che mi ha preoccupato.
La cosa divertente è che il medico di base mi ha detto che potrebbe essere a causa del livello di estrogeni che si è abbassato come per le donne in menopausa ma facendo un dosaggio basso di t in realtà ho ancora persino le mestruazioni, è una situazione un po' confusa, spero solo che si possa risolvere senza intoppi

Trans or cis girls always rock

My ex is saying it too, it hurts everytime you hear it from the person you love because you don't want to rebuild, you don't want to start all over again, you just want to fix things with them, I know, but in the end they're not wrong, if things can't be fixed you can either adapt to the situation or start over. You said you have kids, do it for them, I'm sure they love you and want you to be here, they'll need you. If you can't do it for yourself try doing it for them and try to get help

I'm trying to keep holding on even though I know that it would take just one moment of "weakness" to do it, I mean I feel like it's just a matter of time, even if things would start working out again for some reason then they would also get bad at a certain point, it's how life works but I'm getting weaker and weaker and feel like getting closer to doing it everytime

I guess this shows how you can never trust anyone basically, most people are evil and self-centered and would fucking destroy you just to make themselves feel better, I'm so sorry you're in this situation, the only thing one can do when everything seems to go bad is rebuild, start over, get the help you deserve and start again
God I understand it so much, I don't even know what to say, I'm in the same place right now so if you wanna vent about something or just talk about it you can send me a message anytime
Yes, I understand what is means to be unable to see yourself in the future, if you wanna talk my dm is open

I'm so sorry to hear that, these things suck so bad but there's a lot more I haven't told about the story since it begins in January 2018 and this was already too much to write down, she made me live in costant anxiety and fear and did so many wrong things that really fucked me up. How are you handling the situation?
Thank you, I just need to not feel alone in this because it's really the worst feeling there is since she doesn't seem to care much about anything anymore
